ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Exrex is a command line tool and python module that generates all - or random -
matching strings to a given regular expression and more. It's pure python, without
external dependencies.

There are regular expressions with infinite matching strings (eg.: [a-z]+),
in these cases exrex limits the maximum length of the infinite parts.

Exrex uses generators, so the memory usage does not depend on the number of
matching strings.

name: exrex
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: exrex
  version: "0.12.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3f582add0700d4141e279625252e7a0655f9ad81feab3b8ab9077966668a2c99

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - exrex
      pip_check: false
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"

about:
  license: AGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Irregular methods on regular expressions
  description: |
    Exrex is a command line tool and python module that generates all - or random -
    matching strings to a given regular expression and more. It's pure python, without
    external dependencies.

    There are regular expressions with infinite matching strings (eg.: [a-z]+),
    in these cases exrex limits the maximum length of the infinite parts.

    Exrex uses generators, so the memory usage does not depend on the number of
    matching strings.
  homepage: https://exrex.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/asciimoo/exrex
  documentation: https://exrex.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - scopatz
    - jan-janssen
